app.name: BidPilot
app.tagline: Find it, decide it, answer it.

today.title: Today
today.subtitle: New notices, deadlines this week, and alerts from your library.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.subtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No notices} one {# notice} other {# notices}} matching your profile.
opportunities.keyboardHint: Shortcuts: j/k to navigate, s shortlist, d dismiss, p pursue.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your proofs, references and reusable content.
library.expiring: {count, plural, =0 {No documents expire} one {# document expires} other {# documents expire}} within 30 days
library.expired: {count, plural, =0 {No expired documents} one {# expired document} other {# expired documents}}

notice.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

matches.title: No notices yet
matches.body: As soon as a notice matches your profile it will appear here. Check your watch profiles if you were expecting results.

tenders.title: No live consultations
tenders.body: Choose "Pursue" on a notice to open its workspace: analysis, then decision, then drafting.

library.title: Your library is empty
library.body: Add your first three proofs — company registration, social and tax attestations. Eligibility stays "unknown" until they exist.

signIn.title: Choose a demo organisation
signIn.body: This demo environment contains three organisations, one per persona in the specification. Auth.js sign-in is not wired yet.

siret.title: Your SIRET or SIREN
siret.body: We pre-fill your company details from the official registry. You confirm them next.
siret.notFound: No company found for that identifier.
siret.unavailable: The registry is temporarily unavailable. You can enter your details manually.
siret.invalid: A SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) is expected.

confirm.title: Confirm your details
confirm.body: These come from the official registry. Correct anything that needs it — nothing is saved until you confirm.

scope.title: Your scope
scope.body: What you do and where you work: this is what decides which notices you see.
scope.revenueHint: Used to flag tenders that are disproportionate to your size.

done.title: Monitoring is active
done.body: These are the notices matching your profile.
